Preemptive use of intravenous ibuprofen to reduce postoperative pain after lower third molar surgery: a systematic review of randomized controlled trials. This study aimed to systematically review the literature to assess the effect of preemptive intravenous ibuprofen on pain reduction after lower third molar surgery. A Descriptive Comparison of Phase 3 Results and Head-to-Head Trials in Inflammatory Bowel Diseases. With the increasing number of effective therapies for inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD), determining optimal treatment sequences is challenging. Given the impracticality of conducting randomized head-to-head trials for every comparison, this study assessed whether phase 3 placebo-controlled trials can reliably predict outcomes of published head-to-head studies.
